## SpessaSynth library

The synthesizer and AudioWorklet are generated during CI from
`spessasynth_lib@4.4.8`, by Spessasus, licensed under Apache-2.0.

Upstream: https://github.com/spessasus/spessasynth_lib
License: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

Do not replace the worklet with a different library version. The bundled
JS/worklet files must be generated from the **same npm package**.

## Privacy and deployment

These are software and instrument samples, **not user songs**.
Only bundle/code/font files may be deployed on public GitHub Pages.
Private MP3/M4A/VIDEO/MIDI and karaoke lyrics stay in user-authorized
private Google Drive and are never published as part of these assets.
